firm_data.firm_description: Burner Prudenti Law, P.C. is a women-owned law firm providing legal counsel to New Yorkers in need of estate planning and wealth management advice. Their legal advocates help ensure clients' wishes are heard and reflected in any plans they make for the future.
notable_facts: The firm was founded as Nancy Burner & Associates, P.C. in 1995.
Judge Gail Prudenti joined the firm as Partner in August 2023.
The firm has offices in Long Island and Manhattan.

email.subject: AI for Burner Prudenti Law, P.C. built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Britt,

Your work in Trust and Estates on Long Island reflects something we see across the country: complex client needs that demand precision and deep personal attention. That's exactly why we built Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar practices compete with BigLaw on their terms.

Worth 20 minutes to explore how this might work for Burner Prudenti?

Vasu
Lucio
